updates.note: Management stated that they will maintain their margin guidance.
updates.quote: our view for the period in the future is we will maintain our margin guidance

updates.note: Management reiterated the plan to recruit 20,000 college graduates for the year and through March.
updates.quote: We have recruited 20,000 college graduates this year and through March, that will be the number.

new_promises.statement: Infosys plans to recruit 20,000 college graduates in the next financial year.
new_promises.quote: And next financial year, we also have a plan to recruit 20,000 college graduates
new_promises.speaker: Salil Parekh
